text_block_list.text:
Alright, got all the daily essentials.
Guess it's about time to head home~

text_block_list.text:
Ah! There you are, Nature Daimajin!
Take this: Carrot Man Kiiiiiick!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! It's the kid from the vegetable shop?!
Out of nowhere, this makes zero sen—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Ugh... All those expectant gazes are piercing right through me...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Guh... Gwaaahhh~!
What an attack that waaas~!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger's Child
text_block_list.text:
They flinched!
To arms, everyone! Punish them~!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chaan! Thanks a bunch~!
See ya~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
A child's stamina... is truly terrifying...
